title: Last day working in the fields
summary: He cannot recall his last day in the fields; the interviewer says his father said he left without his pay.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well tell me about it. The last time you ever worked in the fields out in the country, your last day, what was that like? Well, I don't know, let me see. The last time I was awake. I think your daddy told me about this.
Yeah. I can't remember now the last time.

Well, just that he told me that you went out there and, uh, you laid the hole down and never came back. He left. Right, right. Didn't get you pay or anything. Never. But anyway, uh, I wanted to ask you about, uh, that clarinet player from out of the country that quit playing. You know the man I'm talking about? Oh yeah.
